tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Full-text search over SOC 2 Compared's Published providers. Returns compact records (name, slug, tagline, url). Fetch depth with get_listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One provider in full, as answer-first markdown: the summary, then every question on the sheet with its answer, the vendor's own words for it and the URL that proves it. Identical to /{slug}.md and to the HTML page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: SOC 2 Compared's categories with their live listing counts, 0 for one with none yet.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Two providers side by side, as markdown: taglines, pricing, API availability, tags — the researched compare facts, honest about unknowns.

tools.name: get_best_of
tools.description: The Published providers in one category, in the order its category page prints (ranked by what we can confirm: a public price, an API and docs, independent sources, stated limits), as a markdown answer sheet. Payment never moves a row.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit a provider to SOC 2 Compared: the url alone; we write its name and description from its own pages. Requires an existing signed-in account with verified email; send its session Cookie header on the MCP request, or an agent key the account made at https://soc2compared.com/dashboard/agents as Au

tools.name: send_lead
tools.description: Send a buyer-intent enquiry (lead) to a provider or a whole category on SOC 2 Compared. Keyless. Requires consent:true, a real name, a permanent (non-disposable) email, a message of at least 20 chars, and a target (listingSlug OR categorySlug). Returns { ok, delivered }. Idempotent by (email, target

tools.description: What the SOC 2 Compared owner dashboard shows about the listings an account owns: each one's status (`status.kind`: review with the expected date, accepted with `liveOn` and `paid` ('express' | 'featured' | null: the paid way that releases it, Featured including Express review), live, refused with t

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email to the SOC 2 Compared digest of new and freshly re-verified providers. Provide an email; returns { ok }. The address is on the list at once and gets one welcome mail. Every mail carries a one-click unsubscribe.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, submit_listing, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: submit_listing, send_lead, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, submit_listing, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: submit_listing, send_lead, my_listings, subscribe_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
